title: How a backyard pool is built

beats.text: Two months ago, this pool was just a lawn.
Step one: a plan. The shape, the depth, and every single pipe.
Step two: find what's buried! Gas and power lines get painted, so nobody digs into them.
Stakes and string draw the pool right onto the grass.
Then, the fun part! A mini excavator scoops out twenty-five tons of dirt.
One and a half meters deep. Max can barely see out!
Gravel goes down for a solid base.
Then the plumbing: a drain at the bottom, jets in the walls.
A steel cage, with a bar every twenty-five centimeters.
Then concrete gets blasted on at high speed. It's called shotcrete!
It cures for four weeks, watered every day so it won't crack. Max... wake up!
Tiles at the waterline, stone around the edge.
Smooth plaster seals it all up.
Fill it fast: fresh plaster cures best underwater! Twelve thousand liters.
A pump cleans every drop about every six hours.
A little chlorine, and a pH of seven point four.
Now, where were we? Oh yeah...
